title: For ports that are DOWN and belong to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a8
question: For ports that are DOWN and belong to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list only those ports whose security group has more ports bound to it than the average number of ports per security group (computed across all security groups). Show the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the security group ID from the security-group-to-port binding, and the rank of each port within its security group when ordered by port ID. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH sg_port_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        security_group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS port_count
    FROM securitygroupportbindings
    GROUP BY security_group_id
),
avg_sg_port_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_count
    FROM sg_port_counts
),
qualified_ports AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS port_id,
        p.tenant_id,
        p.mac_address,
        b.security_group_id,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS rank_in_sg
    FROM ports p
    JOIN securitygroupportbindings b ON p.id = b.port_id
    WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
      AND p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57'
)
SELECT 
    qp.port_id,
    qp.tenant_id,
    qp.mac_address,
    qp.security_group_id,
    qp.rank_in_sg
FROM qualified_ports qp
JOIN sg_port_counts spc ON qp.security_group_id = spc.security_group_id
CROSS JOIN avg_sg_port_count avg_spc
WHERE spc.port_count > avg_spc.avg_count
ORDER BY qp.security_group_id, qp.port_id
